metadata.description: Git-native agentic OS for Claude Code: versioned agents, skills and instructions with hook-enforced governance, MADR decision records and a three-layer memory stack.

plugins.name: core-orchestration
plugins.description: Authoring and release discipline for the agentic OS: atomic commits per core change, MADR decision records, skill/agent authoring conventions and SemVer release flow.

plugins.name: governance-gates
plugins.description: Hook-enforced quality gates: secret guard, manifest and SemVer validation, atomic-commit enforcement, ADR gate and a structured audit trail of every tool call.

plugins.name: memory-obsidian
plugins.description: Three-layer memory: Obsidian vault as the human knowledge base, a local SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-vec hybrid retrieval index, and durable session memory captured at session end.
